source_status: Bank-specific deployment adaptations; these do not pad or alter the reconstructed canonical 19.

operators.name: paper.bank.metric_tree_likelihood
operators.computation: Fit one component's native metric to aligned app MRT values; validate on a heldout chronological baseline suffix; compare per-observation alert residual likelihood with the heldout baseline reference; score the actual component membership using explicit excess-NLL gates.
limitations: component metric units remain native and field-specific
insufficient aligned support or failed validation abstains

operators.name: paper.bank.trace_root_flow
operators.computation: Fit a shared multicomponent model from non-root inclusive span durations to unique explicit trace-root durations; use historical heldout validation and report component contribution changes.
limitations: root spans are excluded as predictors
duplicate IDs, cycles, unresolved parents, nonunique roots, missing feature coverage, collinearity, or failed validation abstain
parent closure does not establish complete tracing

operators.name: paper.bank.log_pattern_contrast
operators.computation: Discover row-local hashed token motifs from pooled, label-blind native log lines; use Aho-Corasick to count motif support within each line; compare per-block motif composition rates with explicit multiple-test correction.
limitations: motifs are not session event sequences
no cross-line or cross-window sequence construction
raw log text is not returned
time-block denominators control for uniform log-volume changes
pattern capacity or token-bound overflow marks only this capability unsupported
